load_bearing_risk_resolution: The /nix/store-sharing (S41bdf2-1-4) DOES make an installed tool run inside a container. No NSS/locale/CA-cert/store-path-escape edge case blocked either — the read-only /nix/store closure share was sufficient under the Ubuntu userland.
